messages:
Maria CSM: Quick kickoff: prepping Orion QBR + renewal negotiation. Need a short 10-slide deck + 15m workshop. Key asks: pilot timeline, burst capacity clause, and security sign-off. Who takes what? :mag: 

Devon CSM: I can do the health one-pager (metrics + NPS) and a slide with churn/renewal signal. Will include recommended playbook for at-risk accounts.

Priya OPS: I’ll build the usage trend slides and derive top-5 feature usage. Will anonymize workspace ids. Need raw query from infra.

Omar ENG: dropping the query here, will export CSV.

```sql
-- daily usage and p95 latency by feature
SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS day, feature, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) as active_users, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) as p95_latency
FROM telemetry.orion_events
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '90 days'
GROUP BY day, feature
ORDER BY day;
```

CSV link: https://drive.google.com/orion-qbr-telemetry-export.csv (permissions set to internal).

Len Product: I’ll draft the enablement workshop flow + checklist for onboarding 2 new feature owners. Planning a 30-min hands-on lab. Need customer environment details. @Maria CSM can you share access level?

Maria CSM: Sent access tiers in the doc: read-only for product PMs, staging creds for Raj (Eng). Shared link: https://docs.redwood/orion-qbr-plan.

Amy Exec: I’ll prepare the executive ask ladder: 1) pilot approval (4 weeks), 2) burst commit option for peak month, 3) SLA bump to 99.9 for dedicated. Each ask needs one short benefit bullet + ask rationale.

Suresh (Customer): Quick reminder from our side: security team requires encryption-by-default for egress, and an IP allowlist for pilot. Can Legal review bursts clause?

Legal Bot: Upload request received. Please attach proposed clause draft; we’ll triage. 

Devon CSM: I’ll draft a mitigations / fallback slide: fallback models, throttling policy, and temporary credits. Also mapping of risk to exec ask priority.

Priya OPS: question 5: show token spend per feature normalized vs last quarter? Good idea?

Maria CSM: yes, show normalized spend delta and highlight efficiency gains from caching. Do not expose raw $ amounts. Use percent change.

Omar ENG: latency screenshot + CSV uploaded to drive. Also added a short script to reproduce dev env on customer's staging cluster in the doc: 

```bash
# staging setup snippet
export ORION_ENV=staging
./scripts/seed_test_data.sh --days=30 --users=50
docker-compose -f docker-compose.staging.yml up --build -d
```

Len Product: added workshop exercises and a 10-min demo recording, uploaded to slides folder.

Calendar Bot: Internal dry-run scheduled for Mon 2026-04-13 16:00 PT. Customer-facing session tentative Tue 2026-04-14 10:00 PT, pending Suresh confirmation.

Maria CSM: Action list (assignments + due times):
- Devon CSM: upload health one-pager + risk ladder (due Mon 10AM PT)
- Priya OPS: usage trends + normalized spend charts (due Mon 1PM PT)
- Omar ENG: final CSVs + staging script (done)
- Len Product: enablement workshop + demo clip (due Mon 4PM PT)
- Amy Exec: three executive ask slides + rationale bullets (due Mon 4PM PT)
- Legal Bot / Legal team: review burst clause draft (due Tue AM)

Please drop :white_check_mark: when uploaded to https://drive.google.com/orion-qbr-slides-master

Devon CSM: :white_check_mark: health one-pager uploaded (v1).

Priya OPS: :white_check_mark: usage charts uploaded, added notes on normalization approach.

Amy Exec: working on ask phrasing, will upload by 3PM.

Suresh (Customer): Confirming Tue 10 PT works for execs. Security will join the workshop and needs the dataflow diagram before the meeting.

Omar ENG: will add dataflow diagram and short compliance checklist to the doc by EOD.

Legal Bot: Requested clause uploaded: sources/legal/drafts/orion-burst-clause-v1.docx (internal). I’ve assigned review to Legal team.

Maria CSM: Thanks. One last note 5 we should prepare a short post-QBR follow-up template: decisions, owners, due dates, and renewal next-steps. I’ll draft and post after the customer meeting. 

Devon CSM: LGTM. Also proposing we offer a 2-week technical check after pilot start as a goodwill item. Add to ask ladder? :handshake:

Amy Exec: Yes add as a near-term commitment slide. Makes the renewal ask softer.

Maria CSM: Great. Closing prep thread 5 will circulate final master and run notes 1h before dry-run. If blockers, call them out here. :rocket:
